summary.text: Sarah Morris is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Denny Canterbury Jr.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner and caregiver from Ronceverte.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Morris graduated from Greenbrier East High School and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from the University of South Florida.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in Ronceverte, left to build skills and perspective, and returned to Greenbrier County.
She said her experience includes work as a small business owner, caregiver and community volunteer.
Morris was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.

In the survey, she named access to health care close to home, affordable utility and grocery costs, rural infrastructure, support for working families and caregivers, and voting access for rural, elderly, disabled and military voters as her priorities.
